newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london quiet, Tokyo ends weak.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london quiet, Tokyo ends weak.

text.p: Japanese shares trading in London were generally weaker in thin trade on Friday after Tokyo stocks continued to retreat on profit-taking.
"No-one in London was prepared to put any more money in, the market was very quiet," one dealer said.
London's Nikkei/Ise 50 index was up 0.76 point at 1,442.43 just ahead of the close.
"After the U.S. (jobless) figures there was a small recovery but not much," a trader said. "Trade was one-way...people were taking profits."
In Tokyo the Nikkei 225 share average lost a further 183.47 points or 0.86 percent to settle at 21,148.03
